hash_1_03_03.desc: Returns 1 if input equals 2; returns 0 if input equals 0; returns 2 if input equals 1; returns 6 if input equals 5; returns 9 if input equals 8; returns 10 for all other inputs.

hash_2_03_03.desc: Returns 0 if input equals 0; returns 2 if input equals 1; returns 1 for all other inputs.

hash_3_03_03.desc: Returns 0 if input equals 0; returns 2 if input equals 1; returns 5 if input equals 4; returns 8 if input equals 7; returns 1 for all other inputs.

ite_lt.desc: Returns the second argument if the first argument is less than 0; otherwise returns the third argument.
